timingMethod: Actual automated browser operations at the public addresses. Captions use observed wall-clock event times aligned to recorded clip durations. Separate owner and recipient browser clips are joined in operation order; no UI is simulated.

chapters.en: Open the public cloud workspace in a fresh 390-pixel mobile browser.
chapters.zh: 在全新390像素手机浏览器中打开公开云端工作台。

chapters.en: Compute and save a real cloud mission on the mobile layout.
chapters.zh: 通过手机界面完成真实云端计算与任务保存。

chapters.en: Refresh and reopen the original mobile mission.
chapters.zh: 刷新手机页面，重新打开原始任务。
